name: Preview Image
summary: Simple image preview node that displays an image received from an upstream connection. Accepts one image input and renders it with an optional label. Pass-through output allows chaining to downstream nodes.

inputs.description: Image to preview (base64 or URL). Auto-receives from upstream when connected.

outputs.description: Pass-through of the received image — allows chaining to other nodes.

executionNotes: Display-only node. Content is received automatically via useEffect when upstream data changes — no manual execution required. The node renders the image with object-contain scaling (max 400px height). An optional text label field allows annotating the preview. Equivalent to ComfyUI's 'Preview Image' node.

exampleConnections.scenario: Preview a generated image before passing it to further processing.
Preview the selected talent's image from Morpheus catalog.
